items.title: GLP-1s and SGLT-2s may help slow kidney damage in diabetes, study shows
items.summary: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and sodium glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT-2) inhibitor drugs slow decline in kidney function in people with type 2 diabetes, but the benefits are only seen if they also have albuminuria, a large US ‘real-world’ study has reported.

items.title: Fight Fibrin Sheath campaign launches to push dialysis catheter innovation
items.summary: A clinician-led coalition including the Vascular Access Society, European Kidney Patients Federation and BioInteractions has launched the Fight Fibrin Sheath campaign.
